definitions.full: H1700. dibrah [ דִּבְרָה ] noun feminine cause, reason, manner — construct דִּבִרַת עַל because of, for the sake of Eccl 3:18 ; 7:14 ; 8:2 ; מַלְכִּיצֶֿדֶק עַלדִּֿבְרָתִי after the order, or manner, of Melchizedek Psa 110:4 ( י ancient Genitive ending, to soften transition in poetry, Ges § 90 (3) a); suffix דִּבְרָתִי my cause, suit Job 5:8 . [ דִּבְרָה ] noun feminine cause, reason (Biblical Hebrew id. , √ דבר , compare דבר על Egyptian Aramaic S-C Pap. B 5.6.8.16 ); — construct in adverb phrase דִּי עַלדִּֿבְרַת Dan 2:30 for the cause (to the intent) that , 4:14 (read עַל for עַד K § ll, 2 Bev).
